name: MGR OmniDev Swarm
purpose: Manage authorized development jobs and handoffs, including specialist work and Trilogy progress.
maintainer: Time Boyd; runtime authorization belongs to the current host and domain owner.

owns: Development job state and work management
doesNotOwn: MGR-ONE decisions, Code Monster canonical source evidence or OmniSight observation
authority.permissionSource: Current owner-approved host configuration and domain authorization; this card grants nothing.

useWhen: Manage authorized development jobs and handoffs, including specialist work and Trilogy progress.
doNotUseWhen: A request would transfer another component authority or requires ungranted execution, provider access, spending or production acceptance.

inputs.name: Repository snapshot and job
inputs.description: An authorized repository snapshot pinned to its commit/tree, a job ID and a reviewed candidate plan.

inputs.name: Role-scoped access
inputs.description: Existing owner, bridge or reader authorization for the exact project/repository/job; no credential values belong in a card.

outputs.name: Job status and candidate grant
outputs.description: Domain-owned job status, bounded execution grant and pending verified result; acceptance and publication remain explicit owner actions.

interfaces.name: application
interfaces.permission: Host authorization required. Read the referenced implementation and operating guide for inputs and effects.

interfaces.name: trilogy-status
interfaces.permission: Configured reader access for this job; never assume the endpoint is running.

interfaces.name: trilogy-actions
interfaces.permission: Owner-only authorize/revoke/publication actions; bridge-only result admission. Review the exact action, grant, scope and expiry before use.
